instruction: Require complete, mutually consistent nextVersion and nextTag metadata before classifying a plan as future, use precision-safe ordering or reject unsafe numeric components, and add the corresponding negative fixtures before reevaluation.

findings.summary: A future plan with only nextVersion or only nextTag is classified as valid and permits candidate preparation.

evidence_refs.lines: latestPlanTargetRelation accepts plannedVersion ?? plannedTagVersion when either counterpart property is absent; the added invalid-metadata fixtures do not cover partial targets.

findings.summary: Version ordering converts arbitrary semver numeric components to Number, so values beyond the safe-integer range can compare incorrectly.

evidence_refs.lines: parseStableReleaseVersion returns Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]), and Number(match[3]), then compareStableReleaseVersions subtracts those values.
